readings.moment: When the temple bell struck nine, at dinner (watches were then shown)
Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine when his uncle had everyone show their watches
Félix heard a thump on the floor right above him, in the atelier
Uncle's repeater struck ten slow deep notes, heard after the thump
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door
Someone came quickly down the stairs
Bastien Girard came into the library
The temple struck eleven, when Félix and Girard had been sitting together in the library

durations: Félix and Girard sat together in the library from Girard's arrival (10:32 by Félix's watch) until the temple struck eleven
whereabouts: Félix was at the dinner table when his uncle had everyone show their watches
Odile was at the table and did not look up during the watch incident
The doctor was at the table and laughed
Girard was at the table and said something rude about Félix's watch movement
Girard and the uncle quarrelled about the price at dinner
Félix went up to the library with his brandy after the watch incident and stayed there alone
Félix was in the library when he heard the thump and the repeater
The uncle lay down in the atelier, the room directly above the library
An unidentified person went quickly up the stairs past the library door at 10:15 by Félix's watch
An unidentified person came quickly down at 10:21 by Félix's watch
Bastien Girard came into the library at 10:32 by Félix's watch
Félix and Girard sat together in the library until the temple struck eleven
